why: ./testing exports a second harness class whose own name is PctButtonHarness, under the key PctButtonAgainHarness, beside the real one exported as PctBtnHarness too; the refusal names each harness once, with all of its keys. A harness is named by its own name, as its declaration is, so point 5 would hold both to the one `declare class PctButtonHarness` and the second to a list that is not its own.
